column1: Indicators of economic activity and employment have continued to strengthen.
Job gains have been strong  in recent months, and the unemployment rate has declined
substantially.  Inflation remains elevated, reflecting  supply and demand imbalances
related to  the pandemic , higher energy prices, and broader  price pressures.
The invasion of Ukraine by Russia is causing tremendous human and economic
hardship.  The implications for the U.S. economy are highly uncertain, but in the near
term the invasion and relate d events are likely to create additional upward pressure on
inflation and weigh on economic activity.
